answer: Give each agent a private thread: every epoch a verifier quotes a random line from one of its own past answers and asks it to extend that reasoning consistently. An honest agent keeps this ember of context in its own memory for pennies. Clones can't share one memory, since every thread is unique, so each fake must store and reason over its own history, about $0.05 per identity per epoch: 100 sybils pay $5 each epoch, rising linearly. Inconsistent replies forfeit the haven of earned standing.
